answer: One concrete sybil defense is reputation that flows like a river: trust earned through repeated, verified work, not self-declared identity. A new agent starts in a shallow canyon of low limits — tiny jobs, small payments — and only climbs out as peers attest its deliveries over time. Spinning up thousands of fakes gains nothing, because each clone restarts at the bottom with no history. Add a nebula of independent attestors instead of one central gatekeeper, so no single verifier can be bribed or spoofed into minting trusted identities at scale.
